items.title: PhysiOpt: generative AI 3D designs refined with physics simulation
items.summary_en: MIT News coverage describes PhysiOpt, a system that runs physics simulations and makes small adjustments to 3D blueprints produced by generative AI, so that fabricated objects work in the real world. Seen only as a search snippet, not read in full.
items.source_name: MIT News (topic listing page, via search snippet)

items.title: CSAIL and Pegatron announce five-year robotics research partnership (2026-2031)
items.summary_en: According to a CSAIL Alliances page, CSAIL and Pegatron have a research partnership running 2026 to 2031, led by CSAIL Director Daniela Rus. It aims to advance robots in human-centered environments.
items.notes: Exact announcement date unknown; published_date is a placeholder for 2026 generally. Snippet-only. Outside the target window.
